locations.name: Meadow
locations.description: A peaceful field of grass and flowers.

locations.name: Forest
locations.description: A dark, foreboding collection of tall trees.

locations.name: Pond
locations.description: The water shimmers more than other ponds you have seen...

locations.name: Valley
locations.description: The valley stretches off into the distance. When shadows fall over parts of the valley, the shadows tremble ever so slightly.

locations.name: Desert
locations.description: The hot sands burn and the sun grows ever more oppressive.

locations.name: Mountain
locations.description: These mountaints are capped with snow, and something else you can't quite identify. At the top of the tallest mountain is a tower made from black stone. The snow doesn't stick to it...

locations.name: Clouds
locations.description: The clouds are made of water, yet you can somehow stand on their surface.
